lines: Night had fallen, and the entire area was covered in darkness.
Ohhhh! It's giving a nice atmosphere to it! Hebiko, Shikanosuke, let's go! Let's infiltrate this castle!!
The real "adventure" was finally starting.  We were going to infiltrate that castle and find out the secret hidden in Yukikaze's house!!
Come ooon. Why are you two so excited over this? Don't come crying to Hebiko if anything happens.
Despite her grumbling, Hebiko followed along with us.
Relaaax Hebiko. I'll buy you another ice cream when we get back.
F-Fine... But it's not like Hebiko is coming with you just to get ice cream, got it?
Hebiko is just worried that you two will do something weird in Yukikaze-chan's house...
Mwahaha, don't you worry. We'll get out of there quick if need be.
As we discussed those things, we suppressed our presence and approached the castle.
A cold wind caressed our necks.
H-Hey, Fuma, isn't it suddenly a little...
Hebiko's got a bad feeling about this...
The bushes all around us were swaying and rustling.
Were they swaying because of the wind?
Suddenly, something came flying out of the bushes.
Wh-What is this!? A scarecrow monster?!?
An uncountable number of scarecrows came out from the bushes around us. And on top of that...
In an instant, our surroundings became dark as if filled with ink.
Did someone turn the mansion's lights off??!?
This is... did they notice us trying to infiltrate the castle!?
If that was the case then these strange scarecrows were a trap for repelling attacks.
It can't be. If she found an intruder she would probably want to deal with them directly.
S-She probably would... So this means that it could be that girl, Clear!?
No, I don't think Clear is able to use scarecrow monsters like this...
The person who was controlling this group of scarecrows was neither Yukikaze nor Clear.
『Yukikaze is also living alone right now, so I think it will work out perfectly.』
Asagi-sensei had said so herself after the incident with Clear, didn't she?
Ooohhhhhh, they're comiiing!!! Wha-Wha-What do we do, Fuma!? Should we just go home!?
We can't leave when it's just getting this good! ーWe're breaking through them!
Aiiiieeee, for real!? We're so finiiiiiiiiiished!!
Shikanosuke-chan, you were so excited just moment ago...
